textos.As imagens do deserto e as sequências co: The desert imagery and the sequences with the giant worms were described as visually impressive and breathtaking, with many considering that every frame could be a work of art.

textos.Dirigido por Denis Villeneuve e lançado: Directed by Denis Villeneuve and released in 2021, Dune is a science fiction adventure set in a distant future ruled by a feudal interstellar empire. The plot follows the family of young Paul Atreides as it takes control of the hostile desert planet Arrakis, the only source of the valuable spice Melange.
textos.A experiência do filme é marcada por uma: The film's experience is marked by a slow cadence and a setting focused on the grand scale of the desert universe. The narrative bets on a dense atmosphere, structured with a prominent sound design and a predominantly introductory function.
textos.Os três grupos concentram seus comentári: The three groups concentrate their comments on the same aspects of the production, diverging in the verdict rather than in the subjects addressed. Among the vast majority of ratings (~79%), most highlight the stunning cinematography, while about half stress the presence of a striking soundtrack. In addition, a significant share of this band praises the immersive world-building.
textos.Para quem se situa numa parcela das nota: For those in a share of ratings (~16%), many point to the slow pace and lack of action, although a good portion acknowledge the world-building and impressive sets. In this same segment, a portion report a lack of emotional connection with the characters. From the perspective of a minimal fraction of ratings (~5%), several point to the slow pace and boredom during the screening, a considerable number criticize the lack of emotional depth and empty characters, and some point to a confusing story with excessive exposition.
